title: Update Promotion Activity
label: TIKTOK SHOP · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Updated 2026-10-15
html:
Path: /promotion/202309/activities/{activity_id}

Method: [PUT]

Function Description

Update an existing promotion activity. The stored activity type determines which request fields are processed:

  • For fixed-price, direct-discount, and flash-sale activities, update title, begin_time, and end_time; the other type-specific fields are not processed by this update path.
  • For a shipping-discount activity, provide discount.shipping_discount; use duration_type to choose a scheduled or indefinite activity.
  • For a Buy More Save More (BMSM) or Buy X Get Y (BXGY) activity, set duration_type to NORMAL, set product_level to PRODUCT or SHOP, provide exactly one participation_limit entry, and provide the matching discount object.
  • For a Gift With Purchase (GWP) activity, set duration_type to NORMAL, set product_level to PRODUCT, provide exactly one participation_limit entry, and provide discount.gift_discount. Fixed-price, direct-discount, flash-sale, BMSM, BXGY, and GWP activities cannot be updated after they are deactivated or expired. For those activity types, an upcoming activity with a normal schedule requires a future begin_time, while an ongoing activity must keep its existing begin_time. An ongoing BMSM or BXGY activity must also keep its existing first-tier threshold value, threshold type, discount type, product scope, participation limit, and target-user setting.

Request Body Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
title string Y BlackFridayDiscount Activity name. The name must be unique. Maximum length: 50 Unicode characters for a flash-sale activity; 50 characters for a shipping-discount activity; 100 Unicode characters for a fixed-price, direct-discount, BMSM, BXGY, or GWP activity.
duration_type string N NORMAL The activity schedule mode.
  • For BMSM, BXGY, and GWP activities, set this field to NORMAL and provide the scheduled begin_time and end_time.
  • For a shipping-discount activity, use NORMAL for a scheduled activity or INDEFINITE for an activity without a scheduled end. When this field is omitted for a shipping-discount update, it defaults to NORMAL. For INDEFINITE, set both begin_time and end_time to 0.
  • This field is not processed when updating a fixed-price, direct-discount, or flash-sale activity. | begin_time |int |Y |1661756811 |Activity start time as a Unix timestamp in seconds. For an INDEFINITE shipping-discount activity, set this field to 0. For a fixed-price, direct-discount, flash-sale, BMSM, BXGY, or GWP activity with a normal schedule, use a future time when the activity is upcoming; if it is ongoing, use its existing start time because that value cannot be changed. | end_time |int |Y |1661856811 |Activity end time as a Unix timestamp in seconds. For an INDEFINITE shipping-discount activity, set this field to 0. For a normal-schedule fixed-price, direct-discount, flash-sale, BMSM, BXGY, or GWP update, end_time must be at least 600 seconds after begin_time. | product_level |string |N |PRODUCT |The promotion's product scope. You must provide this field when updating a BMSM, BXGY, GWP, or shipping-discount activity.
  • PRODUCT: Applies to a product and all of its SKUs. Use this value for GWP; BMSM, BXGY, and shipping-discount also support it.
  • VARIATION: Applies only to specified SKUs. It is not supported for BMSM, BXGY, GWP, or shipping-discount updates.
  • SHOP: Applies to all products in the shop. It is supported for BMSM, BXGY, and shipping-discount, but not GWP. This field is not processed for fixed-price, direct-discount, or flash-sale updates. For an ongoing BMSM or BXGY activity, keep its existing PRODUCT or SHOP scope. | participation_limit |[]object |N | |The buyer participation limit. For BMSM, BXGY, and GWP updates, provide exactly one entry. If a BMSM or BXGY activity is ongoing, keep its existing participation limit unchanged. | ^type |string |Y |BUYER_NO_LIMIT |Determines whether the promotion limits how many orders each buyer can receive the benefit from.
  • BUYER_NO_LIMIT: Buyers can receive the benefit across multiple orders.
  • BUYER_LIMIT_ONLY_ONE: Each buyer can receive the benefit for no more than one order. | discount |object |N | |Discount information. | ^shipping_discount |object |N | |Configurations for the shipping discount, including purchase criteria, discount value, shipping method, inventory type, and area scope. | ^^threshold_type |string |Y |MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY |The type of purchase criteria. Possible enumerations are:
  • NO_THRESHOLD: No minimum purchase criteria.
  • MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible products.
  • MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible order. MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY and MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT can only be set when product_level==SHOP. | ^^threshold_value |string |N |3 |The purchase threshold for the shipping discount, interpreted according to threshold_type.
  • When threshold_type is NO_THRESHOLD, this field is not required.
  • When threshold_type is MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY, enter the minimum number of eligible products the buyer must purchase. The value must be an integer.
  • When threshold_type is MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT, enter the minimum eligible-product subtotal in the shop's local currency, for example, 3 units of local currency. The value should have no more than two decimal places. | ^^type |string |Y |DISCOUNT_SHIPPING_FEE |The shipping benefit type.
  • FREE_SHIPPING: Reduces the buyer's shipping charge to zero.
  • DISCOUNT_SHIPPING_FEE: Reduces the buyer's shipping charge by up to the amount specified in shipping_discount.value. | ^^value |string |N |10.5 |The shipping discount amount.
  • When type is FREE_SHIPPING, omit this field.
  • When type is DISCOUNT_SHIPPING_FEE, enter the maximum amount to deduct from the buyer's shipping charge in the shop's local currency. The value must have no more than two decimal places. | ^^shipping_method |string |N |STANDARD_SHIPPING |The shipping methods to which this promotion applies.
  • When STANDARD_SHIPPING: Only applies to Standard Shipping methods, including Economy.
  • EXPRESS_SHIPPING: Only applies to Express Shipping methods.
  • ALL_SHIPPING_METHOD: Applies to all shipping methods that the shop offers. Default: STANDARD_SHIPPING | ^^inventory_type |string |N |SELF_FULFILLED |The inventory types to which the promotion activity applies:
  • SELF_FULFILLED: Only applies to Inventory fulfilled from seller warehouses
  • FULFILLED_BY_TIKTOK: Only applies to Inventory fulfilled by TikTok from FBT (Fulfilled by TikTok) warehouses.
  • ALL: Applies to all inventory of eligible products. Default: SELF_FULFILLED FULFILLED_BY_TIKTOK and ALL can only be set when product_level==SHOP and threshold_type=NO_THRESHOLD. | ^^area_scope |object |Y | |The (buyer's) geographical areas to which the promotion activity applies | ^^^type |string |Y |WHOLE |The buyer's geographical area to which the promotion activity applies.
  • WHOLE: The promotion activity applies to all areas to which the seller offers fulfillment.
  • SPECIFIC_AREAS: The promotion activity applies only to fulfillment areas listed in area_scope.specific_areas. | ^^^specific_areas |[]string |N |["Washington", "New York"] |The list of areas for which the promotion activity applies. The valid values that may be included in this list are dependent on the region of the shop. The list of valid values for each shop region are available here: link | ^bmsm_discount |object |N | |Configurations related to Buy More Save More (BMSM) promotions | ^^details |[]object |N | |Configurations for BMSM promotions. A maximum of two tiers is permitted. threshold_type and type must be the same across all tiers. When updating an activity, each value must also match the activity's existing threshold type and discount type. | ^^^tier |int |Y |1 |The 1-based tier number. Use 1 for the first tier and 2 for the second tier. For each tier after the first, both threshold_value and value must be greater than the corresponding values in the previous tier. | ^^^threshold_type |string |Y |MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY |The type of purchase criteria. Possible enumerations are:
  • MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible products.
  • MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible order. | ^^^threshold_value |string |Y |5 |The purchase threshold for the discount, based on threshold_type.
  • When threshold_type is MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY, enter the minimum number of eligible products the buyer must purchase. The value must be a positive integer.
  • When threshold_type is MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT, enter the minimum eligible-product subtotal in the shop's local currency. The value must be positive and have no more than two decimal places. | ^^^type |string |Y |PERCENTAGE_OFF |The type of discount awarded as a benefit. The value of the discount is determined by value. Possible enumerations are:
  • PERCENTAGE_OFF: Buyer will receive X% off the price of the eligible products.
  • AMOUNT_OFF: Buyer will receive X units of local currency off the price of eligible products. | ^^^value |string |Y |10 |The positive discount value, interpreted according to type.
  • When type is PERCENTAGE_OFF, enter the percentage off eligible products as a positive integer.
  • When type is AMOUNT_OFF, enter the positive amount to deduct from eligible products in the shop's local currency, with no more than two decimal places. | ^gift_discount |object |N | |Configurations related to Gift With Purchase (GWP) promotions. Only needs to be configured for GWP promotions. | ^^gift_receiving_type |string |Y |ALL_RECEIVE |The receiving type of gift. Currently only one type is supported:
  • ALL_RECEIVE: All gifts configured in the promotion can be collected. | ^^gift_infos |[]object |Y | |Gift With Purchase (GWP) tier configurations. Provide at least one tier. A maximum of two tiers is permitted in SEA and the UK; only one tier is permitted in the US. threshold_type must be the same across all tiers. | ^^^tier |int |Y |1 |tier uses 1-based indexing, i.e. the first and second tiers are counted "1, 2", not "0, 1". threshold_value for a given tier must be greater than that of the previous tier. E.g. If tier1 has threshold_value2, tier==2 must have threshold_value > 2. | ^^^threshold_type |string |Y |MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY |The purchase threshold type of discount. The threshold type of each tier must be consistent. Possible enumerations are:
  • MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible products.
  • MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT: Buyer must meet or exceed the minimum spend criteria with eligible order. | ^^^threshold_value |string |Y |3 |The positive purchase threshold for receiving the gift, interpreted according to threshold_type.
  • When threshold_type is MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY, enter the minimum number of eligible products the buyer must purchase. The value must be a positive integer.
  • When threshold_type is MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT, enter the minimum eligible-product subtotal in the shop's local currency, for example, 3 units of local currency. The value must be positive and have no more than two decimal places. | ^^^gift_details |[]object |Y | |The gift SKUs for this tier. Across all tiers, provide at least one gift SKU in total, and do not repeat a sku_id anywhere in the activity. For a MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY tier, this list must not be empty. | ^^^^product_id |string |Y |1732239744891062847 |TikTok Shop product id of gift. | ^^^^sku_id |string |Y |1732239787859544639 |TikTok Shop sku id of gift. | ^^^^total_claim_limit |string |Y |100 |The quantity limit of the gift sku which is involved in the activity. Possible values:
  • MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY: The buyer must purchase at least the specified number of eligible products.
  • MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT: The eligible-product subtotal in the buyer's order must meet or exceed the specified amount in the shop's local currency. | ^^threshold_value |string |Y |5 |The purchase threshold for the discount, interpreted according to threshold_type.
  • When threshold_type is MINIMAL_ITEM_QUANTITY, enter the minimum number of eligible products the buyer must purchase. The value must be an integer from 1 to 10.
  • When threshold_type is MINIMAL_ORDER_AMOUNT, enter the minimum eligible-product subtotal in the shop's local currency. The value must be positive and have no more than two decimal places. | ^^discount_type |string |Y |AMOUNT_OFF_EACH |The type of discount awarded as a benefit. The discount amount or percentage is determined by discount_value. Possible values:
  • PERCENTAGE_OFF: The buyer receives the percentage specified by discount_value off eligible products.
  • FREE: The buyer receives the eligible products for free.
  • AMOUNT_OFF_EACH: The buyer receives the amount specified by discount_value, in the shop's local currency, off each eligible product. | ^^discount_value |string |Y |5 |Value of the discount.
  • When type==PERCENTAGE_OFF, the buyer will receive X% off the price of eligible products. If the value represents a percentage, it should be an integer.
  • type==AMOUNT_OFF_EACH, the buyer will receive X units of local currency off the price of each eligible products. If the value represents a monetary amount, it should be limited to two decimal places. | ^^benefit_max_applicable_quantity |string |Y |5 |The maximum quantity of item Y that can receive the BXGY benefit per application. Enter a positive integer from 1 to 20. | ^^benefit_max_applicable_times |string |N |5 |Optional. The maximum number of times the BXGY benefit can be applied within a single order. Enter a positive integer from 1 to 50. | target_user_info |object |N | |The promotion's target-user configuration. For an ongoing BMSM or BXGY activity, keep the existing target-user setting unchanged and include that existing value in the request. | ^user_type |string |N |ALL_USER |Possible enumerations are: ALL_USER SHOP_NEW_CUSTOMER SHOP_EXISTING_CUSTOMER SHOP_REPEAT_CUSTOMER | auction_support_type |string |N |ALL |Determines whether a shipping-discount activity supports auction products. This field is not processed for other activity types. Possible values:
  • ALL: Supports both standard and auction products.
  • EXCLUDE_AUCTION: Excludes auction products. When omitted for a shipping-discount update, defaults to ALL. |
